prompt: The group of older walkers walks towards the camera along the path past the railings, chatting, at an easy pace. The strap stays exactly where it is and keeps its shape; the shell is rigid and never bends. The phone stays still beside the path. No text, no music.

risks.prevented_by: rigid-shell clause, strap stays where it is
one plain action at a named easy pace

risks.risk: camera travels with the subject and warps the frame
